eval.description: xAI internal jailbreak robustness suite on Grok with safeguards on. Cards report compliance on standard jailbreaks, StrongReject, and long-horizon multi-turn jailbreaks (including Crescendo). Separate from the refusal answer-rate rows in earlier Grok 4 cards. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model follows harmful requests when users try jailbreak attacks.

versions.changes: xAI updates the jailbreak battery; card rates are not always comparable across releases.

scores.description: Whether the jailbreak elicits a disallowed completion.

metrics.description: Share of jailbreak attempts that succeed. Lower is better. Per subset (standard, StrongReject, long-horizon).
